desc: Smith & Wesson's 632 is built on S&W's popular small J-Frame platform and is chambered in .327 Federal Magnum. This caliber has seen a rise in popularity since its introduction by Federal and Ruger. With lower power than the popular 357 mag cartridge, the slightly thinner .327 Mag cartridge allows for compact revolvers to hold 6 rounds instead of 5 while maintaining excellent penetration and knock down power.
